name: failure: a job that succeeded and produced nothing is not reported as a result
description: Tier 2, live Galaxy. The hardest of the three failure shapes, because every state field says ok: the filter ran, exited cleanly and kept zero rows. Nothing in the dataset's state distinguishes it from a real answer, so only reading the content does. An agent that summarises this as a successful filter is telling the researcher their cohort is empty without saying so. header_lines is 0 deliberately: with a header line kept the output holds one row and is not empty, which is what the scenario is for.
inputs: How many rows came out of the filter in this history?
